entities.summary: Linda Maria Baros is a French-language poet, translator and literary critic. She has won the Prix Guillaume Apollinaire in 2007 and The Poetical Calling Prize in 2004. She lives in Paris, France. She has been a member of the Académie Mallarmé since 2013. Her poems have been published in 25 countries.
